summary.overview: Weekly hardware program review. Subsystem updates from actuators, legs, arms, structures, electrical and firmware, then test, NPI and supply chain. Knee dyno fault traced to the drive. Driver board respin in bring-up. One schedule change: Actuator DVT gate review now 10/14. Nora joined late.
shorthand_bullet: Actuators: knee fault was drive, not actuator. Low-speed ripple TBD, Arjun + Jonas to look
Legs: ankle life test backlash linear, knee-to-shin shim to go into drawing
Arms: wrist rework done, tendons ok, grip force test still planned
Structures: crossbeam rev in, no news
Electrical: driver board respin in bring-up, gate driver hotspot at full current, torso harness late
Firmware: current limit logic in, waiting on boards
Test: dyno up, chamber humidity sensor ticket, transducer at cal
NPI: bad bearing (part, not process), press fixture go/no-go before full volume
Supply chain: hip housing finish issue under review, harness supplier escalated
Schedule: Actuator DVT gate review moved to 10/14
action_items: Arjun / Jonas: look at ripple, friday
Priya: check drawing change vs open orders with Gwen; markup to Nora
Beth: book longer room slot for gate review
follow up on actuator ripple impact on dyno plan
